dataset.name: Source-gated WTC 1 stairwell geometry and model-treatment audit
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V9P, use only cached official PDFs and an existing indexed government report, document the three WTC 1 stairways, their broad vertical continuity, enclosure construction, impact-zone qualitative positions, NIST mass and partition treatment, and damage-state evidence. Do not create solver geometry or assign mass, stiffness, strength, failure, or load-path credit.

required_terms: eliminated the need for any framing

stairways.impact_zone_qualitative_position_north_u: northeastern member of the clustered three-stair group
stairways.position_provenance: derived visual observation from NCSTAR 1-2B Figure 9-124; not metric and not to scale

stairways.impact_zone_qualitative_position_north_u: northwestern member of the clustered three-stair group

enclosure_construction.support_description: planks in metal channels at floor and ceiling slabs; metal tongue-and-groove side channels; no separate framing

mass_treatment.future_double_counting_warning: Do not add discrete stair or enclosure mass on top of the NIST density-scaled core live/dead load without a traceable subtraction or remapping.

damage_evidence.floor_92: official report transcribes eyewitness accounts that all three were impassable; the base calculation showed no core disruption, but its assessment was limited because core partition walls were absent on floors 92 and 93
damage_evidence.floor_93: eyewitness wording says floor 92 and possibly above; model assessment limited by missing core partitions; Figure 9-124 is illustrative model output
damage_evidence.floors_94_to_96: official base-case model states damage or debris made all three appear impassable
damage_evidence.floor_97: shown in Figure 9-124, but the adjacent text does not extend the all-three-impassable conclusion beyond floor 96
damage_evidence.floors_98_to_100: not resolved by the audited stairwell-damage passage
damage_evidence.global_official_summary: NIST states that all WTC 1 stairwells in the impact region were destroyed by aircraft impact
damage_evidence.epistemic_note: eyewitness reports, official model results, and the NIST summary conclusion are distinct evidence classes

evidence_policy.observed_or_transcribed_fact: A page-verified statement, dimension, source identity, or visual position directly present in a cached source.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: A NIST calculation or modeling choice, including the base-case damage and simplified partition treatment.
evidence_policy.indexed_government_report: The cached 9/11 Commission text and its PANYNJ-attributed continuity statements; not a NIST structural model or as-built drawing.
evidence_policy.user_requirement: The future tower model must explicitly account for three stairwell enclosures.
evidence_policy.derived_result: Unit conversion, floor-by-floor continuity matrix, source coverage count, or qualitative topology mapping.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: Any future geometric placement beyond the documented qualitative topology.
evidence_policy.contradiction_or_unknown: Exact coordinates, floor-specific offsets, flight and landing geometry, steel details and connections, discrete masses, and component-level damage.

next_iteration.objective: Preserve V8U through V9Q and perform a bounded primary-plan gap closure for the three WTC 1 stairways. Search first for NIST NCSTAR 1-7 and traceable PANYNJ or architectural drawings that expose metric floor plans, the exact 42-48 and 76-82 transfer geometry, stair flights, landings, stringers and connections. Digitize only source-visible geometry with scale or fixed landmarks. Keep all mass, stiffness, strength, damage and solver gates closed if the primary geometry remains incomplete.
